source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the structure of RNA (PDF 174).

blocks.text: RNA aam taur par DNA ke ulat aik dhaage (single stranded) wala hota hai, lekin is ki zanjeer khud par mur kar helix jaisa loop bana sakti hai. RNA ki ribonucleotide zanjeer mein ribose sugar, chaar nitrogen wale bases (A, U, G aur C; thymine ki jagah uracil) aur phosphate group hote hain (Figure 27.16). Cells mein RNA ki teen bari qismein hain.

blocks.alt: RNA ka aik akela dhaaga helix ki shakal ke feete jaisa, jis se bases nikle hain, har aik par A, U, G ya C likha.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.16: RNA ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 27.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Messenger RNA (mRNA): nucleus mein DNA se copy kiya gaya genetic naqsha (blueprint) le kar jata hai.
Ribosomal RNA (rRNA): ribosome banane mein madad deta hai.
Transfer RNA (tRNA): mRNA ki nucleotide tarteeb ko protein mein amino acids ki mutabiq tarteeb mein badalta (translate karta) hai.

blocks.caption: DNA aur RNA ka muqabla
rows: maloomat le jana aur protein mein badalna (mRNA, tRNA, rRNA)

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa base RNA mein hai lekin DNA mein nahi?
blocks.explanation: Uracil (U), jo thymine ki jagah leta hai.

items: RNA: aik dhaaga, ribose sugar, bases A, U, G, C.
mRNA genetic paighaam le jata hai; rRNA ribosome banata hai; tRNA amino acids ki tarteeb banata hai.
